question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.

The bacteria in the roots of leguminous plants __submerge__ nitrogen in the soil to compounds.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Convert'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence we will use '**convert'** instead of** 'submerge'.**
 
• Let's see the meaning of the correct option:
 
 
• **Convert - **to change from one form, system or use to another.
 
 
• Example: I must **convert** sorrow into strength.
 
 
 
• **Submerge -** to go or make something go under water.
 
 
• Example - The fields were **submerged** by the floods.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let's see the meanings of other given options:
 
 
• **Propose -** to formally suggest something as a possible plan or action.
 
• **Expand -** to become or to make something bigger.
 
• **Analyse - **to look at or think about the different parts or details of something carefully in order to understand or explain it.
 
 

Hence, the correct sentence is *The bacteria in the roots of leguminous plants** convert __**nitrogen in the soil to compounds.*
